structured_output.what_is_happening: A swarm of 'Effective Accelerationism' (e/acc) clone tokens appeared within about 15 minutes. The GeckoTerminal handle points to a beffjezos status link, so a Beff Jezos post probably set off the launches. This token (EsVb...) is one of at least 10 same-name copies. It is a pumpswap pool that did not come from a pump.fun curve (non-pump address, deploy platform unknown, migrated_unix 0). Its LP is 100% unlocked, and liquidity ($35k) is larger than market cap ($29k), which suggests the creator seeded the pool with a lot of LP. The price rose about 180-220% in its first ~10 minutes, then gains slowed to about +6% over the last 5 minutes. The leading clone, CbcyNo7..., launched about 5 minutes earlier and sits at about $438k market cap with $1.6M hourly volume, so it has taken most of the attention.

narrative.description: e/acc / Beff Jezos meme, probably set off by a fresh post from @beffjezos. The theme is well known in crypto and tech circles.
narrative.why_spreading: A post from a well-known figure on a familiar theme set off rapid clone launches. The attention, though, is split across 10+ same-name tokens and mostly pooled in the earliest, largest one.

token_connection.why_this_token: Same name and ticker, and it links the same Beff Jezos status. Nothing marks it as the canonical token: no website, no socials, no DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7... (earliest of the swarm, ~$438k market cap, $1.6M hourly volume, the clear leader). 45bRFaf... ($258k) and 6TrwU9... ($145k) are both ahead of this one. Several others sit at $22-53k, and an older 2024 e/acc token (GqmEd...pump) also exists.

authenticity.evidence: There are 1,301 unique buyers but only 64 unique sellers, and the buy:sell ratio is about 4:1. GMGN counts 43 bundler wallets, and the top bundler traders account for 25.6% of trading. The bot/degen rate is 16.7%. There are no smart-money or KOL wallets and no paid promotion. The huge buyer count relative to a $29k market cap looks like small bot or sniper buys spread across a clone swarm.
authenticity.uncertainty: X data is missing, so we can't tell whether any real community is backing this specific contract.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a custom pumpswap pool, so the creator can pull liquidity at any time
Liquidity larger than market cap suggests a creator-seeded pool, a typical setup for a clone-farm rug
43 bundler wallets, with bundlers making up about 25% of top trading
Many same-name competitors, with the leader already more than 10x larger
Momentum fading: +6% over the last 5 minutes after +180% over the hour

structured_output.counterargument: The e/acc name is strong and Beff Jezos has a big following. If the leading clone runs to seven figures, laggard copies sometimes get sympathy pumps. At $29k market cap, a 2x only needs a small rotation of buyers, and 1,300 unique buyers shows real traffic. Mint and freeze authority are renounced, and the creator holds nothing.
unknowns: Whether Beff Jezos endorsed any specific contract

structured_output.thesis: This is a non-canonical copy in a clone swarm built around a Beff Jezos post. Its LP is fully unlocked on a pool the creator seeded, bundler activity is heavy, and a leader more than 10x larger launched 5 minutes earlier. The most likely outcomes are an LP pull or a slow bleed as attention settles on the leader. The chance of doubling before halving is low.
